text.p: -- Caspian Securities said it started coverage of Mexican pharmaceutical distributor Nacional de Drogas SA de CV, or Nadro, with a rating of market performer.

-- "Although Nadro is well positioned to benefit from higher demand and prices of pharmaceutical products in Mexico, we believe its current estimated (price/earnings ratio) of 12.8x for 1997 largely reflects expected growth given the stock's low liquidity and concerns of increased competition in the sector," analyst Esteban Galindez wrote in a Jan 7 report.
-- "Our 12-month price target is 29.52 pesos per share, representing a nominal peso return of 32 percent and a U.S. dollar return of 15 percent, including a 1.5 percent dividend yield."
-- The company's shares closed at 22.70 pesos on Wednesday in Mexico City.
